TradingView's answer is known (the day's last regular-session bar, `vw-lower-tf-spy-1d-2026-09-30`); it is not served until a stored `/api/bars/<ticker>?tf=15` payload has been compared with TradingView's 15-minute bars for the same sessions (`storeIntradayAgreement`). ⚠️ THIS IS NOT THE SAME REQUEST: `timeframe.period` reads the timeframe the chart is on rather than forcing one, so decide whether that is what you meant before you take it.
